regime_read: The strongest measured alignment is concentrated in semiconductors, enterprise AI, and selected idiosyncratic situations, but several signals rely partly on sentiment or affiliations rather than confirmed capital flows. With no completed track record, conviction remains modest and near-extended PLTR is a watch rather than a chase.
regime_read_zh: 当前较强的多源信号主要集中在半导体、企业级AI及部分特殊情形，但若干组合仍较依赖情绪或关联关系，而非已确认的资金流。由于尚无已完成评分的历史记录，整体置信度保持克制；接近涨幅过度区间的PLTR仅适合观察，不宜追涨。

theses.thesis: MU has the clearest non-extended alignment: net congressional buying by multiple members, strongly positive insider purchase activity, a large patent cluster, and bullish community sentiment all point in the same direction [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]. Its recent relative underperformance leaves a more favorable entry than the crowded AI leaders, while the disclosed Ro Khanna affiliation adds context but is not treated as a stand-alone signal [actor:Ro Khanna].
theses.thesis_zh: MU呈现最清晰的非过度上涨型多源共振：多名议员净买入、显著为正的内部人购买活动、大规模专利集群以及看多社区情绪方向一致 [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]。近期相对SPY落后，使其入场条件优于拥挤的AI龙头；已披露的Ro Khanna关联仅作为背景，而非独立依据 [actor:Ro Khanna]。
second_order: AMAT — memory-capacity investment would support semiconductor-equipment demand
Semiconductor manufacturing equipment — higher memory investment can propagate upstream to fabrication tools
theses.dissent: The government-grant acceleration is modest and bullish social sentiment may be coincident rather than predictive.

falsifier.text: Congressional and insider buying reverses while patent activity fails to translate into improving memory investment.

theses.clamped: lean 'overweight' → 'underweight' (deterministic witness); conviction 'medium' → 'low' (deterministic ceiling); action 'ACCUMULATE' → 'AVOID' (deterministic ceiling)

theses.thesis: LUV combines an activist-linked catalyst, repeated material disclosures, and measured consumer engagement through app demand [activist_13d] [material_8k] [app_demand]. The disclosed Paul Singer affiliation supplies a credible change-agent channel [actor:Paul Singer], while substantial relative underperformance suggests expectations are not already elevated.
theses.thesis_zh: LUV同时具备维权投资催化、连续重大事项披露及应用端消费者需求信号 [activist_13d] [material_8k] [app_demand]。已披露的Paul Singer关联提供了可信的变革推动渠道 [actor:Paul Singer]；明显跑输SPY则表明市场预期尚未被充分抬高。
second_order: Airline suppliers — successful operational restructuring could stabilize fleet and service spending
Domestic travel ecosystem — stronger execution at a major carrier would support airports and travel services
theses.dissent: High app ratings and reviews measure customer engagement but do not establish improving unit economics or successful activist execution.

falsifier.text: Material disclosures produce no observable operating changes and app-demand momentum weakens.

theses.clamped: lean 'overweight' → 'underweight' (deterministic witness); conviction 'medium' → 'low' (deterministic ceiling); action 'ACCUMULATE' → 'AVOID' (deterministic ceiling)

theses.thesis: MSFT's alignment spans end-user demand, developer activity, model-download momentum, and a broad patent cluster [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster]. The factual Sam Altman partnership connects that activity to the enterprise-AI distribution channel [actor:Sam Altman], while the disclosed Bill Ackman affiliation is supportive but qualitative [actor:Bill Ackman].
theses.thesis_zh: MSFT的信号覆盖终端用户需求、开发者活动、模型下载动能及广泛的专利集群 [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster]。与Sam Altman的事实性合作关系把这些活动连接至企业AI分发渠道 [actor:Sam Altman]；已披露的Bill Ackman关联提供辅助支持，但属于定性信息 [actor:Bill Ackman]。
second_order: NVDA — expanding enterprise-AI workloads can increase accelerator demand
Data-center infrastructure — cloud and model usage require additional compute, networking, and power capacity
theses.dissent: Strong usage and developer metrics may not translate into incremental margins if AI infrastructure costs rise as quickly as monetization.

falsifier.text: Developer and model-download momentum decelerates without corresponding improvement in enterprise AI demand.

theses.thesis: GOOGL shows aligned consumer demand and developer momentum while materially lagging SPY, creating a non-extended setup [app_demand] [github_momentum]. Nancy Pelosi's disclosed holding adds an independent ownership signal [actor:Nancy Pelosi], although the media-pick and affiliation channels are weaker evidence and keep conviction low [cnbc_pick] [actor:Paul Pelosi].
theses.thesis_zh: GOOGL的消费者需求与开发者动能方向一致，同时明显跑输SPY，形成非过度上涨的入场条件 [app_demand] [github_momentum]。Nancy Pelosi披露的持仓增加了独立持有信号 [actor:Nancy Pelosi]；但媒体推荐及关联渠道证据较弱，因此置信度维持在低位 [cnbc_pick] [actor:Paul Pelosi]。
second_order: NVDA — sustained AI-product usage can support accelerator and inference demand
Digital advertising ecosystem — durable app engagement can support advertisers and measurement vendors
theses.dissent: Developer and app activity may reflect engagement without establishing improved advertising monetization or returns on AI spending.

falsifier.text: App demand and developer momentum weaken while relative performance continues to deteriorate.

theses.thesis: PLTR has the broadest channel count, led by accelerating government contracts and a fully bullish analyst cluster, with retail and Stocktwits sentiment reinforcing attention [gov_contract] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull]. However, the Trump-linked signal is explicitly on the sell side and the stock is only narrowly below the desk's extended threshold, so the convergence does not justify chasing [trump]. Cathie Wood's disclosed affiliation and Marjorie Taylor Greene's disclosed stake are secondary context [actor:Cathie Wood] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene].
theses.thesis_zh: PLTR拥有最多的信号渠道，其中政府合同加速及一致看多的分析师集群最具实质性，散户与Stocktwits情绪进一步强化关注度 [gov_contract] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull]。但特朗普关联信号明确偏卖出，且该股距离本平台的过度上涨阈值很近，因此不宜追涨 [trump]。Cathie Wood的已披露关联及Marjorie Taylor Greene的已披露持仓仅作为次要背景 [actor:Cathie Wood] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene]。
second_order: MSFT — broader government and enterprise AI adoption can support cloud-compute demand
Government AI software — contract acceleration may indicate wider agency adoption of operational analytics
theses.dissent: The contradictory sell-side political signal and heavy sentiment participation raise the risk that contract strength is already reflected in the price.

falsifier.text: Government-contract acceleration reverses or relative strength moves above the extended threshold without a reset.
